grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.candidate_exists: The current scan selected an observed attackable enemy.
predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: The source-derived baseline; no inferred hidden information.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_wave.claim: Using an observed allied footman as the no-target movement anchor may increase productive lane presence and fort wins. This is not evidence that a footman shields a hero from towers.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_base.preference: Preserve nearest-enemy combat and center fallback from the bundled baseline. This is an interpretation of behavior, not recovered original author intent.

G_capacity.preference: Preserve baseline inventory and ordered spending semantics.

G_wave.preference: When there is no observed combat target, join an allied wave instead of walking unconditionally to center. Combat and economy keep baseline behavior.

change.compatible_target_update: 2026.9.10.1: identical game and runtime source trees
